text:
anya: FYI ran the HF->Redwood converter against repo 'gptx-chat-v1' and hit a nasty mismatch when the model has multiple safetensors shards and a pinned revision

sam: what error you seeing?

anya: main error is during load: converter assembled a state_dict where some weight keys were double-renamed. runtime fails with missing keys. also tokenizer special tokens from tokenizer_config.json aren't being applied, so chat template uses raw <|role|> tags

hf-sync-bot: download failed for revision 'rev-2026-03-12': HTTP 403 to https://huggingface.co/org/gptx-chat-v1/resolve/rev-2026-03-12/shard-0001.safetensors

anya: here's the trace:
```
RuntimeError: Missing key(s) in state_dict: "transformer.wte.weight", "lm_head.weight"...
During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:
safetensors.errors.SafetensorException: index file 'pytorch_model.safetensors.index.json' references shard files that don't exist at resolved URL
```

sam: ah, we pin to a revision that had a different index layout. HF returned index from rev A but some shard URLs are behind rev B due to LFS/partial uploads. converter's hub fetcher currently doesn't robustly fall back to unauthenticated mirrors when a 403 happens

anya: also converter mapping: we apply a weight_key_rename map derived from model config, but for some forks both old and new keys appear in the checkpoint and we call rename twice. leads to duplicate->missing sequence.

jen: is this the same toolchain that we used for the last quantization run? could affect quant bits if wrong tensors get mapped

michael: likely. we should treat this as 3 orthogonal issues: 1) hub download auth/fallback for shards + rev pin correctness 2) safetensors index vs shards validation and better error messaging 3) weight-key rename idempotency and tokenizer special token loading order

sam: quick mitigation: i added this patch to the converter to validate index references before download and to abort with the offending URL. also added a fallback that retries without auth token for public repos. small test looks promising.

anya: can you paste the local repro steps?

sam: steps:
1) hf repo: org/gptx-chat-v1 at rev-2026-03-12
2) run: `redwood-convert --from hf --repo org/gptx-chat-v1 --rev rev-2026-03-12 --out /tmp/gptx-rw`
3) observe: `safetensors index references missing shards` or `Missing key(s) in state_dict`

sam: temp patch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/convert-tool/pull/412 (WIP) - adds preflight index check + idempotent rename pass

hf-sync-bot: created issue #2897 in convert-tool: "safetensors shard auth fallback + rename idempotency"

michael: good start. can you also add a unit test that constructs a fake index.json where one shard URL returns 403 and asserts that converter retries without token?

sam: will do. also adding a tokenizer test: ensure special_tokens_map.json and tokenizer_config.json are merged and applied after model loading so chat templates see <|user|>/<|assistant|> tokens

anya: for triage, i ran a quick QA: quant 4bit run failed later in pipeline because embedding weights mismapped. so this is definitely causing wrong evals. need patch before next benchmark sweep

jen: i'll block the model from the evaluation queue and notify bench infra to hold sweeps for 2 hrs

michael: i'll own the PR review and release a hotfix branch for convert-tool once tests pass. tagging @security to eyeball the fallback retry to ensure we don't expose tokens to public repos inadvertently

anya: thanks. opening a follow-up thread in #incidents if the hotfix causes any deploy regressions.

sam: ETA for PR -> hotfix: ~4h. will post updates here and attach failing artifacts

anya: appreciated. :thumbsup:
